name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Exactly one of these is true: Boone goes with 6 lb; Royce goes with Catfish; Pike goes with 10 lb.
Between 6 lb and 10 lb, one goes with Boone and the other with Esther.
Either 10 lb goes with Pike or Esther goes with 8 lb.
